title: China sentences official to death for spying for foreign country
summary_full: Accused official leaked national secrets to unnamed country and received payments worth over $150,000, state-linked publisher saysA Chinese official has been sentenced to death for spying for a foreign country, a government-linked publisher has said.Gold Wall Press, a publishing company associated with China’s national administration of state secrets protection, said the convicted person was surnamed Ma and was approached and recruited by an unnamed foreign intelligence service while working abroad.
